Subject: Renewal + Expansion Sprint Kickoff — QBR dates & stakeholder timeline

Hi Sanjay / Priya —

Congrats again on the successful pilot over the last quarter. Per our conversations, StratusAI is ready to move forward with the renewal and an initial capacity uplift (estimated +30% token throughput to support the new LLM feature). I want to get a short kickoff going today to align timelines, owners, and a QBR slot where we can brief execs.

Proposed agenda for the kickoff: 
- Recap: scope of renewal and expansion (term options + capacity)
- Stakeholder map & decision owners (Sales / Procurement / Engineering / Security)
- Milestones & dates: contract execution, capacity cutover, QBR
- Action items: mutual action plan (MAP) & evidence needed for procurement/security

Request: can you confirm the earliest week you have for a 45-min QBR readout with your execs? We typically run these with the customer exec sponsor + procurement + engineering lead.

I’ve looped in Mateo (CS lead) to coordinate onboarding and the MAP, and Monica for post-sale success planning. Markus is on the thread for approvals on any one-off SLA requests. I’ll circulate a MAP and a draft QBR agenda after we lock a date.

Thanks —
Karthik

Thanks Karthik — this looks good. Quick answers from our side: 

- We are aligned on the +30% throughput target but need clarity on burst capacity for Black Fridays-type events; can we get options in the MAP?
- Procurement needs 3 weeks lead time for contract review and will request SOC2 artifacts. Priya (cc’d) will coordinate.
- For the QBR: the exec sponsor (me) has a 45-min window on Tue May 27 after 1pm PT or Thu May 29 between 9–11am PT. Which works for you?

Action items for Redwood: send a draft MAP with capacity tiers and a brief on fallback policies for capacity shortfalls. Also include a recommended SLA uplift for priority routing.

Appreciate you looping Mateo — we’ll need to confirm an onboarding runbook and the expected handoff date from pilot to production.

Regards,
